messages:
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD / embedger-service / p95-latency spike / eu-west-1 — triggered by deploy-release-2026-03-14-canary
PagerDuty: Incident assigned to @Priya Nambiar (sre-oncall) — priority: P1
Alex Chen: I’m seeing an autopage for embedger in eu-west-1 — anyone oncall? :eyes:
Priya Nambiar: I’m on it, looking at traces and deploy history now. digging into spans.
Maria Gomez: That release is the quant-encoder bump we pushed ~10:12 UTC. Canary only in eu-west-1 and us-central so far.
Priya Nambiar: Confirming correlation — the spike starts right after deploy-bot reported canary roll (10:11). p95 surged from 1.2s -> 3.6s. 5xx rate up ~0.4% total.
Ben Tosh: Not seeing errors at edge layer; errors look inside encoder inference path (kv-cache miss + kernel fallback).
Alex Chen: Any customer-facing degradation? CS, FYI.
Product-CS: A few user-reported slowness tickets, none escalated yet. Customer telemetry shows higher latencies for embeddings calls from EU region.
Priya Nambiar: Likely regression from the quant kernel selection change. Maria — can you confirm what changed in the canary?
Maria Gomez: We switched to the new int8 kernel for the encoder to save perf/cost, but there was a fallback path for long sequences that seems to trigger a slow path on some GPUs.
Deploy-Bot: Canary rollout: release-2026-03-14-canary -> 10% eu-west-1, 5% us-central. Status: complete for those slices.
Priya Nambiar: Immediate mitigation options: 1) pause rollout (stop further canaries) 2) toggle canary back to stable in eu-west-1 3) emergency rollback of the canary release. I’m starting (1).
Maria Gomez: pausing further rollout now — command: `./deployctl pause --release release-2026-03-14` (ran)
Deploy-Bot: Rollout paused: release-2026-03-14 — no new canary batches will be scheduled.
Priya Nambiar: Initiating traffic diversion for embedders in eu-west-1 to stable variant. Routing change in progress.
Ben Tosh: Routing update submitted: `kubectl patch svc embedder -n prod -p '{...}'` — propagation to edge proxies expected ~30s.
Alex Chen: Should we rollback the canary slices already active in eu-west? Tradeoff is losing the quant perf gains vs ongoing customer latency.
Maria Gomez: I’ll prepare rollback for the eu-west-1 canary nodes. Recommended: rollback canary slice only (not full release) to minimize blast radius.
Priya Nambiar: Agreed. Maria — please run the canary rollback. I’ll keep monitoring metrics and notify PD if conditions worsen.
Maria Gomez: Running rollback now — command:
```
./deployctl rollback --release release-2026-03-14 --region eu-west-1 --subset canary
```
Deploy-Bot: Rollback started for release-2026-03-14 (eu-west-1 canary). Progress: 0% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100%.
Priya Nambiar: Observability: p95 trending down back toward baseline (1.3s) after rollback step 70%. 5xx rate decreasing.
Incident-Bot: :white_check_mark: rollback completed; canary slices reverted to stable in eu-west-1.
Product-CS: Notifying impacted customers with a short blurb: "We observed elevated latencies for embeddings in EU; mitigation is in place and performance is returning to normal. Follow-up in 1-2 hours." Will send now.
Alex Chen: Good. Assigning follow up: root-cause triage and postmortem. Maria + Priya to own.
Maria Gomez: Will collect kernel selection logs and reproducer. My hypothesis: kernel selection heuristics choose slow fallback for sequences > 1024 on certain GPU microcode.
Priya Nambiar: I’ll open incident ticket and capture timelines + SLO impact. Quick numbers: impacted requests ~0.4% of global, affected region eu-west spike lasted ~9m until rollback fully applied.
Ben Tosh: Adding note: we saw a small increase in tail memory allocations during the canary, might be related to fallback path overhead.
Alex Chen: Handoff: Lucy Park (night oncall) will monitor the region for the next 4 hours and own pages if anything re-triggers. Lucy — can you ack and take the watch?
Lucy Park: Acked — will monitor dashboards and traces, set a 15m cadence for checks, will escalate to Priya if P95 exceeds 2.0s or 5xx > 0.5%.
Priya Nambiar: Thank you. Also enabling extended sampling for embedder traces for 1 hour to help triage.
Incident-Bot: PagerDuty incident updated: status -> mitigated, responders -> Priya Nambiar, Maria Gomez. Timeline appended.
PagerDuty: Incident note — mitigation in place. If reoccur, incident will escalate to on-call manager.
Product-CS: Customers notified. I'll coordinate any follow-up comms after postmortem conclusions.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. Owners: Priya (oncall lead), Maria (release owner), Ben (obs + kernel logs), Lucy (overnight watch). Please add any postmortem links to the PD ticket.
Priya Nambiar: Creating postmortem skeleton now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1830 (placeholder)
Lucy Park: Monitoring green for now, will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Incident-Bot: Incident resolved by user action. Closing channel thread in 30m unless new messages appear.
